count of what `manual-XtrACTor` already records. Nothing here interprets the

`href` is the Manual's authors linking the provision themselves; `regex` is upstream reading it out of prose. `default` is upstream's inference from a bare 'section 43', not a statement by IP Australia. None of these is collapsed anywhere in this repo (Q-07).

## 5. Ambiguous edges in scope


2 edges carry `certainty: ambiguous` — several instruments of that kind were in scope and upstream refused to choose. They are recorded as ambiguous and never corrected; an ambiguous edge is a reason to put a chunk in front of a human, never a reason to drop it (Q-07, ADR-0022).

- `TMM/Part32B/2/2#1` → `TMA1995/s43`
- `TMM/Part32B/x-relevant-legislation25#1` → `TMA1995/s43`
